phase_title: Runtime Snapshot & Runtime Inspect Context Integration
summary: Implementation phase -- integrates Runtime Context (112C/112D) into the Runtime Inspect subsystem via a new canonical Runtime Snapshot model. Observation-only; no execution capability. Added src/pcae/core/runtime_snapshot.py: RuntimeSnapshot composes 111B's eight Runtime Introspection objects (unchanged, delegated via their own get_*() functions) with a new context: RuntimeContext | None field, populated by build_runtime_context_from_repo() -- a read-only bridge reading .pcae/session.json/tasks/active/ through the same already-governed helpers pcae session bootstrap uses (no new I/O capability). Populates Runtime Session, the active Task, and Observation state (always populated per 112B section 8's Observation always available invariant); Active Phase/Intent/Approval/Broker Decision/Evidence remain explicitly reported as unpopulated, since none has a real governed backing source anywhere in this codebase yet (COMP-003/COMP-007 unimplemented). Refactored commands/runtime_inspect.py's _build_snapshot(registry) into a three-line delegation to Runtime Snapshot, kept under its original 111C name/signature for full backward compatibility with every pre-existing call site. pcae runtime inspect/--json/--verbose all continue to work; JSON schema gains exactly one new, additive top-level key (context), reconfirmed against 111D's own frozen schema-stability tests (deliberately updated to include it, not loosened). Default human-readable output unchanged; new Runtime Context (112E) section appears only under --verbose. Five pre-existing 111C/111D tests deliberately updated with explanatory comments (import allowlist, stable-schema key set, JSON-flatness constraint, 111A doc-text cross-check) -- none silently loosened beyond what the new key required. 35 new tests (tests/test_runtime_snapshot.py); all 101 pre-existing test_runtime_inspect_cli.py/test_runtime_inspect_verification.py tests still pass. Added docs/PCAE_RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT.md, docs/PHASE_112_RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT_INTEGRATION.md.
